title: Synthesis, comparative in vitro antibacterial, antioxidant and UV fluorescence studies of bis indole Schiff bases and molecular docking with ct-DNA and SARS-CoV-2 M(pro).
authors: Singhal, Sugandha; Khanna, Pankaj; Khanna, Leena
journal: Luminescence : the journal of biological and chemical luminescence
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成双吲哚席夫碱并进行ct-DNA分子对接与光谱结合实验，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以传统对接为主、AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: In this study, synthesis of 15 novel bis indole-based Schiff bases (SBs) 4a-4o was conducted by condensation of 2-(1-aminobenzyl)benzimidazole with symmetrical bis-isatins linked via five alkyl chains (n = 2-6). These were subjected to ADME (absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion), physiochemical properties, molecular docking, in vitro antibacterial and antioxidant studies. The in silico studies indicated lower toxicity with metabolic stability for nearly all the derivatives proving reliability as drug candidates. The comparative antibacterial study against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli, also showed a superior inhibition than reference drug and their mono counterparts. The increase in linker alkyl chain length and variation of substituents in indole, further predicted increased inhibition, with maximum value for compound 4o at 50 mug/ml. The in vitro calf thymus DNA (ct-DNA) binding ability of compounds 4c, 4f, 4i, 4l, 4 m, 4n, and 4o was evaluated via ultraviolet-visible and fluorescence spectroscopy techniques. A hyperchromic effect was observed with no apparent wavelength shift which predicted for the groove binding mode. A moderate binding constant for 4o, in fluorescence results, confirms groove binding. The molecular docking of 4o with ct-DNA (PDBID:1BNA) and SARS-CoV-2 M(pro) (3CL protease, PDBID:6LU7) prove its efficacy as potential DNA binder and antiviral agent.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过将2-(1-氨基苄基)苯并咪唑与通过五个烷基链（n = 2-6）连接的对称双靛红进行缩合，合成了15种新型双吲哚基席夫碱（SBs）4a-4o。这些化合物经过ADME（吸收、分布、代谢和排泄）、理化性质、分子对接、体外抗菌和抗氧化研究。计算机模拟研究表明，几乎所有衍生物均表现出较低的毒性和代谢稳定性，证明其作为药物候选物的可靠性。针对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌的比较抗菌研究显示，其抑制效果优于参考药物及其单体制备物。连接烷基链长度的增加和吲哚环上取代基的变化进一步预测了抑制活性的增强，其中化合物4o在50微克/毫升浓度下达到最大值。通过紫外-可见和荧光光谱技术评估了化合物4c、4f、4i、4l、4m、4n和4o的体外小牛胸腺DNA（ct-DNA）结合能力。观察到高色效应且无明显波长位移，预测为沟槽结合模式。荧光结果中4o的适中结合常数确认了沟槽结合。化合物4o与ct-DNA（PDBID:1BNA）及SARS-CoV-2 M(pro)（3CL蛋白酶，PDBID:6LU7）的分子对接证明其作为潜在DNA结合剂和抗病毒药物的有效性。
